jobs.description: Job opportunity: IC Product Engineer Driver Demand for Eyes-Off Download our exclusive market survey Arbe Careers Array ← All Jobs IC Product Engineer Tel Aviv · Full-time About The Position Arbe is leading a RADAR REVOLUTION, driving a zero-road-fatality reality by enabling truly safe driver-assist systems, and paving the way for a fully autonomous-driving future. The next level of road safety is dependent upon a vehicle’s ability to ‘sense’ the world around it. Arbe’s unparalleled 4D high-resolution imaging radar is disrupting the automotive industry by redefining what’s possible. Join our team of technologists, radar specialists, and scientists to make zero road fatalities a reality, for everyone. We are seeking an IC Product Engineer to drive silicon validation, yield optimization, and product maturity from initial tape-out through high-volume manufacturing. In this role, you will act as the technical bridge between Design, Test, Quality, and Foundry/OSAT partners. You’ll leverage advanced statistical analysis to convert complex ATE data into actionable yield and quality improvements.ng requisitions 'from scratch' Responsibilities Yield Learning & Optimization: Drive wafer-level and final test yield enhancement programs. Identify root causes of yield drop, parametric shifts, and low-yield excursions across multiple manufacturing lots. Data Analysis & Reporting: Use JMP, Spotfire, or similar statistical tools to analyze large-scale ATE data (STDF), perform correlation analysis, establish guard bands, and track yield metrics across OSATs and foundries. Silicon Validation & Characterization: Partner with Design and Test teams to define characterization plans, perform shmoo plot analysis, evaluate thermal/voltage margins, and establish production test limits. Production & OSAT Support: Support offshore manufacturing, review yield baseline shifts, drive continuous improvement programs (CIP), and manage product hold disposition rules. Quality & Reliability: Assist Failure Analysis (FA) and Reliability teams in investigating customer returns (RMA), qualifying new packages/process nodes, and supporting ESD/HTOL/HAST qualification tasks. Requirements Experience: Minimum 5+ years of direct experience in IC/Semiconductor Product Engineering (post-silicon bring-up to high-volume production). Statistical Tools: Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with JMP , Spotfire , or equivalent statistical data analysis engines for handling STDF/wafer map data. Yield & Parametric Analysis: Deep understanding of statistical process control (SPC), baseline drift detection, capability metrics (Cpk ), and correlation methodologies (wafer vs. package test). Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field. Preferred Qualifications Test Engineering Background: Direct experience with Automated Test Equipment (ATE) platform hardware and test program development (e.g., Advantest V93000, Teradyne Ultraflex). Foundry & OSAT Interface: Familiarity with fab processes, PCM/WAT data, and packaging assembly flows. Automation: Proficiency in scripting for data extraction and automation (Python, PERL, Tcl, or JMP JSL). Apply for this position Stay up-to-date. Subscribe to our newsletter. Book Demo Industrial-Grade Performance Industrial-Grade Performance Industrial and agricultural environments demand continuous uptime, reliable perception in dust and low visibility, and safe operation around active machinery. Phoenix, Arbe’s high-resolution 4D imaging radar, maintains stable detection and precise tracking where optical sensors degrade. Arbe radar is optimized for SWaP-C requirements and is designed to support retrofitting existing vehicle fleets. Mining operations Construction zones Agricultural fields Industrial yards Port facilities Reliable Perception in Harsh, High-Activity Conditions Industrial sites combine dust, vibration, glare, and constant motion that challenge conventional sensors. Arbe separates closely spaced objects and maintains performance in low visibility and clutter while reducing nuisance alerts. With no moving parts and no field servicing required, it supports continuous operation across active job sites. Safer Operation Around Active Equipment Heavy machinery operates in tight, dynamic zones. Delivering 360° perception, Arbe’s long-range detection enables earlier hazard detection, while near-field sensing supports close maneuvering around vehicles and personnel. High-frame-rate 4D detection with precise Doppler motion measurement distinguishes moving and stationary objects, and high dynamic range separates workers and assets from reflective backgrounds. Ready for RF-Dense, Evolving Sites Industrial yards often deploy multiple sensing systems across fleets and infrastructure. Arbe’s advanced Interference mitigation supports consistent operation even in radar-dense environments, helping maintain autonomy across connected, complex sites and GPS-limited areas. jobs.title: Counter Drone
jobs.description: Ultra-HD Radar for Counter-Drone Protection | Arbe Driver Demand for Eyes-Off Download our exclusive market survey Alerion Ultra-High-Resolution Radar for Counter-Drone Detection Reliable detection and tracking of small drones through the critical zone, where low-altitude flight, complex maneuvers and ground clutter make threats hardest to track. Book Demo The Critical Zone: Hold the Track Where It Matters Most The final approach to a protected asset is one of the most demanding environments for C-UAS sensing. Alerion detects FPV, mini, autonomous, and fiber-optic drones from extended range and maintains track through low-altitude maneuvers and slow or hovering flight, even near trees, buildings, and ground clutter, down to minimum range. Detection holds day or night and through rain, fog, dust, and smoke when optical visibility drops. Strategic Facilities Public Events Critical Infrastructure Mobile Defense Units Armored Vehicles See Small Drones in Dense Clutter Alerion’s 48Tx × 48Rx architecture and 2,304 virtual channels produce the spatial detail needed to separate small aerial targets – including FPV, mini, autonomous and fiber-optic drones – from nearby objects and reduce false alarms. Because detection is based on physical radar returns, Alerion does not depend on an active command-and-control RF link, providing an important sensing layer for autonomous, fiber-optic, and other RF-silent drones. Compact Enough to Deploy Where Protection Is Needed Alerion’s compact, SWaP-C optimized architecture supports fixed sites, mobile units, vehicles, temporary installations, and distributed perimeters. Its solid-state design has no moving parts, supporting rugged vehicle and on-the-move deployment without mechanical scanning or field maintenance. Built on Arbe’s production-proven automotive radar stack, Alerion brings automotive-grade hardware, software, and supply-chain readiness to scalable C-UAS deployment. 135 × 103 × 42 mm Compact form factor 28 W Power consumption –40°C to +70°C Operating range No moving parts Solid-state architecture Radar Data Built for AI and C-UAS Integration Alerion generates dense 4D radar data across range, azimuth, elevation, and Doppler for tracking, clustering, classification, and false-target filtering. Structured outputs support precise slew-to-cue, sensor fusion, C2 integration, and complementary sensors, helping point EO/IR sensors and effectors at a tighter volume for faster positive identification. Air and Ground Awareness Alerion’s high-resolution sensing can also detect relevant ground-level movement, supporting broader awareness around protected assets. Modular 120°– 360° configurations support focused or layered coverage across critical infrastructure, borders, military bases, and other secured facilities. Secure Critical Airspace Connect with our team to learn how Alerion can strengthen counter-drone detection across mission-critical operations. Stay up-to-date. Subscribe to our newsletter.
